spans.s: BP0136 क्लेदः kledaḥ Life: means combination of body, sense organs, mind and soul.
SK0102 क्लेदक कफ kledaka kapha One of the five subtypes of Kapha that causes moistening and loosening of the food particles to help in the process of digestion.
AT0166 क्लेशयते चिरम् kleśayate ciram Affects for a long time.
